item.title: Cryptonomicon
item.author: Stephenson, Neal
item.description: More than fifty years after Lawrence Pritchard Waterhouse and Sergeant Bobby Shaftoe are assigned to Detachment 2702, a secret cryptographic mission, their grandchildren join forces to create a "data haven" in the South Pacific, only to uncover a massiveconspiracy with roots in Detachment 2702.
